segments.text: Queſt. 103d. What doth God require in the fourth Command?

Anſ. Firſt, that the Miniſtry of the Goſpel, and the Schools be maintained; and that I, eſpecially on the Sabbath, that is on the Day of Reſt, diligently frequent the Church of God, to hear his Word, to uſe the Sacraments, publickly to call upon the Lord, and contribute to the Relief of the Poor, as becomes
a Chriſtian. Secondly, that all the Days of my Life I ceaſe from my Evil Works, and yield myſelf to the Lord, to work by His Holy Spirit in me; and thus begin in this Life the eternal Sabbath.
